title: Carbon source-augmented aerobic microbial fuel cell: performance and mechanisms in simultaneous tobacco wastewater treatment and electricity generation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00849B, Paper
Yiming Zhao, Shuhe Ma, Xing Xue, Jian Hong, Yutong Liu, Huaguo Zhang, Zhiyong Wu, Xiaohu Li, Binqiang Tian, Hongtao Lai
